visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and a white t-shirt faces the camera, holding a closed black Decorté concealer palette. He smiles and speaks directly to the lens in a brightly lit indoor room with a white wall behind him. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom center. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the black palette resting on a white windowsill under soft natural light. The brand name 'DECORTÉ' is visible in silver lettering on the lid. The background shows a blurry hint of the outdoors. (3) The man reappears, holding the palette open to reveal four shades of concealer and a small applicator brush. He points at the lightest shade with his right index finger while looking at the camera. Variety text '絕無業配' appears at the top. (4) Close-up of the man's hands as he demonstrates the product's texture. He uses his finger to swipe a swatch of peach-colored concealer onto the back of his left hand. The skin appears moisturized and smooth under the bright studio-style lighting. (5) The man applies the concealer directly under his left eye using his fingertip. He looks into the camera lens as if it were a mirror, gently tapping the product to blend it into his skin. Captions explain the usage for dark circles. (6) A split-screen comparison appears with vertical text '素顏' (no makeup) on the left and '遮瑕後' (after concealer) on the right. A dashed white line separates the two halves of his face, highlighting the reduction in dark circles. (7) He holds up a second product, a Calypso concealer tube, and applies it to his cheek over some acne marks. He then holds both the palette and the tube near his face, smiling widely with his mouth open in an enthusiastic gesture. Large text '買它' appears over his face.
